scenarios.name: Laser Alien (boss)
scenarios.summary: Shoot it, jump and duck a laser a second
scenarios.description: Where teleportlvl1bossend puts the humans after the first boss (teleportzmypali). The first one there trips the trigger_once on the destination, and wall1 across the arena entrance drops 10 s later. Walking into trigger_hp_add_lasers starts the fight: the map's bosshud.js script (point_script script_bosshud, InitBossAlien2) gives the Alien 1 HP + 85 per human (max 20000), every bullet on physbox takes 1 off (OnHealthChanged -> Alien2Damage), and every human a jump or duck laser hits takes 55 off (Alien2DamageLaser). From +1 s laser_timer has logic_laser pick one of 4 lasers every second; each flies at you at 1250 u/s and kills (200000): template_down a thin strip 30 u up (jump), template_up 60-104 u up (duck), template_sideright floor to 62 u (crouch-jump). template_sideleft has no hurt of its own: the map's hurt_side_left is parented to a name only the template has, so it never moves and sits in front of the boss until the first left laser removes it. Win when the script fires laser_boss_dead (HP 0); it opens teleportendmaplvl1 out.
